sentences: Monet painted the harbor of his hometown, Le Havre, as the sun rose.
Cranes and ships dissolve into mist; only the orange sun and its reflection on the water are sharp.
At an 1874 exhibition, a critic mocked the title and called the whole group 'Impressionists,' and the insult stuck as the movement's name.
Curiously, the orange sun has almost exactly the same brightness as the grey-blue sky around it.
In a black-and-white photo the sun nearly vanishes, and that is why it seems to shimmer on the canvas.
Not a finished picture but an impression of a passing moment of light: that was the beginning of a new art.
